tools.name: scribe_health
tools.description: Read-only; changes nothing, touches no room. Times UTC. aspect=all|stt|voice|llm|kb (default all) probes.

aspect.description: picks the tool that runs: all → scribe_health; stt → scribe_stt_health; voice → scribe_voice_health; llm → scribe_llm_health; kb → scribe_kb_probe

tools.name: scribe_system
tools.description: Read-only; changes nothing, touches no room. Times UTC. view=map|stores|stt_engines|stt_routing|stt_tripwires.

view.description: picks the tool that runs: map → scribe_system_map; stores → scribe_store_stats; stt_engines → scribe_list_stt_engines; stt_routing → scribe_stt_routing; stt_tripwires → scribe_route_tripwires

detail.description: [view=map] summary (default) = the fields an operator reads first; full = the complete payload this tool returned before Tier 2. Nothing is removed by summary — it is a narrower selection of the same facts.

tools.name: scribe_rooms
tools.description: Read-only; reads live rooms, changes nothing. Times UTC. view=list|now|fleet|day_report|clusters. tape_advancing does not mean audio is arriving; zero_ratio>=0.98 = digital silence; levels can freeze after a device drop.

view.description: picks the tool that runs: list → scribe_list_rooms; now → scribe_diff_room; fleet → scribe_fleet; day_report → scribe_day_report; clusters → scribe_get_clusters

include_scratch.description: [view=list] also list the fuse's scratch rooms (room_scratch_…); default false

detail.description: [view=now|fleet|day_report] summary (default) = the fields an operator reads first; full = the complete payload this tool returned before Tier 2. Nothing is removed by summary — it is a narrower selection of the same facts.

anyOf.description: [view=now|fleet] optional: one room by id, slug, or exact name
[view=day_report] room id, slug, or exact name

tools.name: scribe_sessions
tools.description: Read-only; changes nothing, touches no room. Times UTC. view=list|replay; replay is a dry run that writes nothing.

view.description: picks the tool that runs: list → scribe_list_sessions; replay → scribe_replay_session

tools.name: scribe_session_tape
tools.description: Read-only; may quote operator notes and presigned audio links; touches no room. Times UTC. view=session|manifest|timeline|chunk|zip.

view.description: picks the tool that runs: session → scribe_get_session; manifest | timeline | chunk | zip → scribe_get_recording (as its mode)

tools.name: scribe_room_levels
tools.description: Read-only; reads live rooms, changes nothing. Times UTC. tape_advancing does not mean audio is arriving; zero_ratio>=0.98 = digital silence; levels can freeze after a device drop.

ist_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Kolkata); default today. The day a clock-time `from`/`to` is read on, and the whole day read when neither is given.

from.description: Range start: HH:MM[:SS] IST on ist_date, or a full ISO timestamp. With `to` omitted the range runs to the end of ist_date.

to.description: Range end, exclusive: HH:MM[:SS] IST on ist_date, or a full ISO timestamp.

limit.description: Buckets returned, default 1000, ceiling 5760 (24 h). A cut answer says truncated and next_from_ms.

tools.name: scribe_room_alerts
tools.description: Read-only; reads live rooms, changes nothing. Times UTC. The Room Watchdog alert outbox (new, late, heartbeat) for the relay.

after_id.description: The highest outbox id the relay has already handled; default 0.

lookback_minutes.description: Window for the late-committer set, default 10, ceiling 60.

limit.description: Cap on NEW rows, default 50, ceiling 100.

tools.name: scribe_room_command
tools.description: WRITE; acts on a LIVE clinical room. Times UTC. kind=start_day|pause_day|resume_day|end_day|close_orphaned_session|set_audio_input|check_update_now|report_diag|restart_engine|self_test. Needs an open kiosk listener (else kiosk_not_listening); start_day idempotent; room_paused is consent; no start/stop on a room with patients without V's GO.

kind.description: picks the tool that runs: start_day → scribe_start_recording; pause_day → scribe_pause_recording; resume_day → scribe_resume_recording; end_day → scribe_stop_recording; close_orphaned_session → scribe_close_orphaned_session; set_audio_input → scribe_set_audio_input; check_update_now | report_diag | restart_engine | self_test → scribe_room_command

room.description: room id, slug (opd-test-a7q9), or exact name (OPD Test)

override_pause.description: [kind=start_day] resume over a consent pause — rare, audited

force.description: [kind=start_day] bypass the room_failing backoff (2+ failed start_day attempts in 60 min)

device_uid.description: [kind=set_audio_input] CoreAudio uid of an input the room reports in input_devices

input_volume.description: [kind=set_audio_input] input volume, 0..1; refused by the app when the device's volume is not settable

args.description: [kind=check_update_now|report_diag|restart_engine|self_test] report_diag: {log_lines?: integer 0..500}; restart_engine: {force?: boolean}; self_test: {volume?: number 0.2..0.8}; check_update_now: omit

tools.name: scribe_list_commands
tools.description: Read-only; reads live rooms, changes nothing. Times UTC. The room command queue (bench_command), newest first.

room.description: room id, slug (opd-test-a7q9), or exact name (OPD Test)

tools.name: scribe_jobs
tools.description: Reads and writes the job queue; submit needs invoke, cancel needs write; a job can read room audio, no live-room command. Times UTC. action=submit|status|list|cancel.

action.description: picks the tool that runs: submit → scribe_job_submit; status → scribe_job_status; list → scribe_job_list; cancel → scribe_job_cancel

args.description: [action=submit] the kind's own arguments; validated at submit

include_urls.description: [action=status] mint presigned URLs for the clip keys in the result. REQUIRES invoke scope: a link is a way to fetch the audio, so it is a stronger permission than reading the row.

tools.name: scribe_audit_recent
tools.description: Read-only; changes nothing, touches no room. Times UTC. Recent audit_log rows, newest first; metadata as stored.

since.description: ISO time; defaults to the last 24 hours

tools.name: scribe_help
tools.description: Read-only; touches no room. One tool's full contract: scope, schema, and the long help text. Accepts any accepted name. Times UTC.

tool.description: Tool name, e.g. scribe_rooms or an older name such as scribe_list_rooms.

tools.name: scribe_usage
tools.description: Read-only; touches no room. Door usage from audit_log: calls, errors, p50/p95 latency per tool and actor. Times UTC.

tool.description: Only calls whose target tool is this name (as called, e.g. scribe_rooms).
